Uses and Administration Chlorobutanol has antibacterial and antifungal properties and it is used at a concentration of 0.5% as a preservative in injections and in eye drops as well as cosmetics. Chlorobutanol has been used as a mild sedative and local analge- sic but other compounds are preferred. It has been used in prep- arations for inflammatory and painful conditions of the ear and oropharynx.
